svg.title: Terraform builds a resource group, network, subnet and NSG
svg.desc: Terraform reads the .tf files on your PC, signs in to Azure with your Azure CLI sign-in (az login), and builds the resource group rg-azb-tf with the virtual network vnet-azb-tf, the subnet snet-azb-tf-app and the network security group nsg-azb-tf-app. The link between the network security group and the subnet is created last. It records what it built in a local state file. The order of work: 1 sign in with az login, 2 write the .tf files, 3 Pass 1 (init, validate, plan, apply), 4 check in the portal, 5 Pass 2 (add the network), 6 change a tag, 7 destroy, which removes everything it built.
svg.text: Local file. Do not commit it
